WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN store_id = 900 THEN 'web' ELSE 'stores' END AS part, SUM(net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 1
),
ctrl AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN store_id = 900 THEN 'web' ELSE 'stores' END AS part, SUM(net_sales) AS ctrl_sales
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND store_id <> 999 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.part, m.net_sales, c.ctrl_sales, m.net_sales - c.ctrl_sales AS gap FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctrl c USING (part)
UNION ALL SELECT 'TOTAL', SUM(m.net_sales), SUM(c.ctrl_sales), SUM(m.net_sales) - SUM(c.ctrl_sales) FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctrl c USING (part)

SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-20' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_receipt_line', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-20' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_return_line_id', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-20' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_web_order', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'rpt_dates_with_p5', COUNT(DISTINCT business_date) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
UNION ALL SELECT 'rpt_999_or_test_effect_cents', CAST(ROUND(100*SUM(net_sales)) AS BIGINT) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND store_id = 999
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_without_dispatch_in_p5_order_dates', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND (w.web_order_id IS NULL OR w.status NOT IN ('delivered','collected'))
UNION ALL SELECT 'max_sale_date', CAST(strftime(MAX(sale_date), '%Y%m%d') AS BIGINT) FROM fact_sales_line
